login.title: Operator login
login.sub: Admin panel of your daily trading competition.
login.note: Only for the operator's admin and Daily Funded. Players log in on the competition site.

setup.title: Set your password
setup.sub: Choose a password for the admin panel. Two-step verification follows after the first login.
setup.done: Your password is set. You can now log in.

security.title: Security
security.sub: Two-step verification protects the admin panel.
security.required: Two-step verification is required before you can use the admin panel.
security.scan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.
security.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app

overview.title: Overview
overview.sub: Today's round and the last 30 days.

rounds.title: Rounds
rounds.sub: Every daily round with its result.

players.title: Players
players.sub: Your players. Suspending ends their sessions and blocks new entries.
players.reasonHint: Required; stored in the audit log.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.referenceHint: The reference of your bank transfer or payment provider.
payouts.note: The platform does not move money yet: pay winners yourself (after KYC) and record it here. Automatic payouts follow with a licensed payment provider.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Your brand and the rules of new rounds.
settings.name: Name
settings.splitHint: Per place, e.g. 50 / 30 / 20 — adds up to 100.
settings.note: Changes apply to rounds created after saving. An open round keeps its rules.
settings.integrationHint: Own domain, logo, website widgets and single sign-on:

audit.title: Audit log
audit.sub: Every action of your operator, unchangeable and hash-chained.
audit.broken: The audit chain is broken — contact Daily Funded.

operators.title: Operators
operators.sub: Companies running the competition. Each has exactly one owner.
operators.name: Name
operators.linkBody: Send this link to the owner securely; it works once and expires in 24 hours.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.load: Could not load this right now.
errors.MFA_INVALID: That code is not valid. Try the next one.
errors.MFA_REQUIRED: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
errors.SETUP_TOKEN_INVALID: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask Daily Funded for a new one.
errors.SETTINGS_INVALID: These settings are not consistent (e.g. prize split must add up to 100% and be descending).
errors.DOMAIN_TAKEN: This domain is already in use.
errors.PAYOUT_NOT_PENDING: This prize is no longer awaiting payout.
errors.OPERATOR_OR_EMAIL_TAKEN: This slug or e-mail is already in use.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.LOGO_INVALID: Logo must be a PNG, SVG, WebP or JPEG of at most 200 kB.
errors.DOMAIN_INVALID: Use your own domain, not the platform domain.

integration.title: Integration
integration.sub: Connect the competition to your own website: domain, logo, widgets and single sign-on.

where.title: Where your players play
where.sub: Your competition is always on your own subdomain; with a verified domain it runs fully under your brand.

domain.label: Own domain
domain.hint: For example competition.your-firm.com. It only goes live after DNS verification.
domain.records: Add these DNS records at your domain provider, then check DNS:
domain.name: Name

logo.title: Logo
logo.sub: Shown in the header, footer and widgets instead of the trophy mark.

widgets.title: Widgets for your website
widgets.sub: Show the countdown, live leaderboard or a join button on your own site with two lines of code.
widgets.originsHint: One https:// address per line, e.g. https://www.your-firm.com. Other sites cannot embed them.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.sub: Your traders open the competition from your website without a second account or password.
sso.enableHint: Your server signs a short-lived token per click (HS256). New players are created automatically.
sso.configured: A secret is set. A new one stops old tokens working.
sso.secretBody: Store it only on your server (e.g. as COMPETE_SSO_SECRET). It is shown once and never again.
